peter-k-parker.text: Running to bring 'classroom experience, honest leadership, and a student-centered vision'; says Trustee Area 4 needs a member who understands instruction, shared governance, curriculum, student services and accountability. Spent 18 years as an Orange Coast College English professor and academic senate president.

source.title: Peter K. Parker for Compton College Trustee Area 4: home page and priorities

peter-k-parker.text: Priorities: put students first, with strong instruction, counseling, tutoring, basic needs support, transfer pathways and career preparation; 'Innovation should serve students—not distract from them.'

source.title: Peter K. Parker for Compton College Trustee Area 4: home page and priorities

peter-k-parker.text: Will advocate for 'policies and budgets that improve access, reduce unnecessary barriers, and help more students complete their educational plans,' and pledges to make decisions openly and responsibly.

source.title: Peter K. Parker for Compton College Trustee Area 4: home page and priorities

juanita-doplemore.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party: November 3, 2026 General Election endorsements

juanita-doplemore.text: (2025) As board president, backed a two-year contract extension for President/CEO Keith Curry through 2029, saying his continuity 'creates the foundation for long-term planning, sustained progress, and real measurable outcomes.'

source.title: 2UrbanGirls: Compton Community College District extends contract for President/CEO Keith Curry (2025-12-19)
